tooltip.stasisdelvers.lance_core.0: At a rift's rim: stack 3+ Stasis Tower Poles on it, then a boom off the mast's top out over the rift's eye.
tooltip.stasisdelvers.lance_core.1: Use a rift focus on it (charged for End rifts). Needs power (FE, e.g. EA's exporter): ~30-50 kW to breach, 10 kW to hold.
tooltip.stasisdelvers.lance_core.2: The breach shrinks the rift to a quarter, then the gate opens: step into the eye. Right-click: status.
tooltip.stasisdelvers.stasis_tower.0: Place two, one on the other: they form a tower core, which runs a stasis field.
tooltip.stasisdelvers.stasis_tower.1: Needs power (FE, e.g. from EA's exporter) on any face; starts at half a store.
tooltip.stasisdelvers.stasis_tower.2: Stack Stasis Tower Poles on top; booms may start from the core's top block. Right-click: status.
tooltip.stasisdelvers.stasis_tower_segme: Survey pole: stack on the tower core's top centre to raise the mast (a wider field).
Use a pole on the mast to extend it upward; sneak-use on its side to start a boom.
Climbable like scaffolding. The tower takes shape around the poles.
item.stasisdelvers.stability_compass.too: Points to the nearest place of safety
item.stasisdelvers.stability_compass.non: The needle spins: no stillness is spreading here
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.root.d: Ways to die where time stands still.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.cow.de: Killed by a cow. Nobody will believe you.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.pig.de: Killed by a pig. It wasn't even a hoglin.
Killed by a sheep. Count yourself out.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.chicke: Killed by a chicken. Fowl play.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.puppet: Killed by something a Puppeteer was wearing.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.self_m: Beaten by your own body. In your own armour.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.low_ba: Frozen with Static on your back. It was hungry.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.end_of: Saw the end of the universe
Try wearing your stasis suit next time!
advancements.stasisdelvers.guide.root.de: The world is ending. Find the high ground, let this gift guide you.
advancements.stasisdelvers.guide.the_cur: Electricity is the only thing that works. Imbue your armour.
advancements.stasisdelvers.guide.sealed_: The mist beckons, and you must not let it touch you. The deeps... at your own recognition.
advancements.stasisdelvers.guide.shards_: Pieces of time, burning for light in the dark. Replenish them with the lifeblood.
advancements.stasisdelvers.guide.fortifi: You've reinforced your suit. The depths are more viable, no?
advancements.stasisdelvers.guide.safe_ha: A pair of cores, to keep each other breathing, and height to let them reach. You'll want a quern for the first inhale.
advancements.stasisdelvers.guide.the_las: They tried. Learn from them, and their mistakes.
This ends where it began, and it watches in dark. Make it see the light.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.its_da: It can still touch you. Seal your skin.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.lights: In a storm, you need a supply of candles, not just one.
advancements.stasisdelvers.deaths.were_t: You were then, and now you-
It wears what you were, not what you are.
message.stasisdelvers.pendant_crumbled: The crystal on your pendant crumbles to dust
book.stasisdelvers.pamphlet.title: Rift Safety
book.stasisdelvers.pamphlet.author: The Government
book.stasisdelvers.pamphlet.page1:
§lWARNING!§0
Temporal stability is falling in your region.

Rest assured the government has your back! Your priority should be to keep yourself safe and maintain productivity until rescue can be arranged.
book.stasisdelvers.pamphlet.page2:
Here are some simple rules to follow, for your safety:

§o1. Follow your compass.§0 The Uppsala Alignment has yet to observe stasis in areas above 80% stability.
book.stasisdelvers.pamphlet.page3: §o2. Do not be afraid of the rift next door!§0 Temporal stability can vary wildly, meter by meter, and living next to a temporal sinkhole is not inherently dangerous.
book.stasisdelvers.pamphlet.page4: §o3. Shelter in a government-approved temporal stasis field if possible.§0 The safeguard towers, and their stasis fields, should be clearly visible from a distance.
book.stasisdelvers.pamphlet.page5: §o4. Do not enter the wandering clouds!§0 They will freeze you, albeit only temporarily. If you must wander through the Deeps, seek protective equipment beforehand.
book.stasisdelvers.pamphlet.page6:
A government-issue delver suit will keep you safe for up to thirty minutes, more with batteries.

§o5. If your child wanders into a Deep and is frozen,§0 then you can extract them with a leash.
book.stasisdelvers.pamphlet.page7: There have been reports of citizens utilising rift crystals to create bootleg, unstable stasis fields and pendants. The government disavows this practice.
book.stasisdelvers.pamphlet.page8:
Such bootleg equipment lasts barely half an hour at most, and cannot be used to speed up work.

Exclusion Zone STRHLD has been established at the Bypass site. Do not approach without a permit and the prescribed defensive measures.
